waves.readOutage: The conductor is off for this session: {{documents}} could not be read from the Distill folder. Waves are not started at all while that is true, so a plan in a conductor chat is ignored. Something was most likely holding the file at launch, such as an antivirus scan or a sync client.

routing.title: Automatic task selection
routing.pageDescription: Choose how Distill selects models for your chats and wave steps.
routing.selectionDescription: Certified selectors choose a provider, model and effort for each task. When no policy applies, Distill uses the category’s fallback order. Explicit model pins stay selected.
routing.certifiedSummary: Certified policies available for {{count}} of {{total}} categories
routing.usageDescription: When an allowance reaches these thresholds, prefer another available platform. Explicit model pins still apply.
routing.waveThreshold: Move wave steps off a platform at
routing.waveThresholdDescription: Prefer another available platform when this much of its allowance is spent. If all platforms are near their limits, an available fallback may still be used.
routing.chatThreshold: Move your own chats off a platform at
routing.chatThresholdDescription: You are in front of a chat and can react, so it may run closer to a limit than a wave step.
routing.classesDescription: Distill selects a provider, model and reasoning effort for each new task. Applicable certified policies take priority; otherwise saved fallback preferences apply. Explicit model pins are respected.
routing.reset: Reset routing to the built-in settings
routing.notPersisted: Routing settings could not be read, so changes here apply to this run only and will be gone after a restart.
routing.fallbackDescription: Optional fallback order. It does not restrict which available models a certified policy may select.
routing.evidenceUnavailable: Task policy status could not be read. No learned policy is confirmed here.
routing.evidenceCertified: Certified task policy available. Each task is evaluated against available models; saved fallback preferences apply if the policy abstains.
routing.evidencePending: No certified task policy yet: saved fallback preferences apply. Qualified cases: {{training}} training, {{heldOut}} held-out; {{fits}} fits, {{campaigns}} comparisons.
